rationale: AEIS needed a frozen worker fleet lifecycle covering registration, heartbeat, rebalance, graceful shutdown and evidence. Existing worker registry routes covered individual actions but did not provide a single audited production lifecycle drill. This change adds a WorkerFleetLifecycle service and operator API for lifecycle drill and graceful shutdown.

steps: Remove worker lifecycle drill routes from sylion.api.worker_routes.
Remove sylion.worker.lifecycle and its export from sylion.worker.__init__.
Restore worker route registry initialization if SYLION_WORKER_DB_PATH causes compatibility issues.
Run worker route, worker lifecycle, project worker reconcile and unified truth tests twice.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that worker fleet lifecycle can register workers, record heartbeat, rebalance assignments, drain a worker, move or block assignments safely and register evidence.
pre_conditions: EvidenceSpine can register inline JSON artifacts.
steps: Run compileall for worker lifecycle and worker API.
Run unit tests for lifecycle drill and blocked shutdown path.
Run API tests for lifecycle drill listing, drill retrieval and graceful shutdown.
Run project worker reconcile regression tests.
Run no-mock scan and git diff whitespace check.
Repeat the same verification scope as PASS2.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Worker lifecycle drill completes with evidence, a drained worker ends offline with no active assignments, assignments move to active capacity when possible, and no assignment is silently lost when capacity is missing.
